## Summary

Describe the change and link related issues (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Changes made

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q securelock_app tests`
- [ ] Manual desktop checks completed where GUI behavior changed (describe results)
- [ ] No real credentials, vault files, keys, or sensitive screenshots committed
- [ ] Encrypted format compatibility preserved, or separately reviewed migration documented
- [ ] Documentation updated if relevant

## Results and limitations

Report actual test results and any untested behavior. Do not claim visual testing was performed if only mocked GUI tests ran.

## Screenshots (optional)

Only use genuine application screenshots with fictional data and all secrets masked.
